title: festpack
description: One festival, one year: lineup, set times, stages, and venue map as portable open data. Draft v0.1.

utc_offset_min.description: Minutes east of UTC for the festival's local time during the event (e.g. -420 for Pacific Daylight Time). Optional but recommended once a pack has real (non-null) schedule times: `timezone` alone requires a full IANA tzdata database to resolve DST, which off-grid/embedded consumers may not carry — utc_offset_min lets them read schedule times correctly without one. Firefly's fp_parse already reads this field (falling back to a fixed default and flagging the schedule as offset-assumed when it's absent) — see docs/specs/S05-festpack.md in jakeholland/firefly.

approximate.description: true when lat/lon is venue-center guesswork, not surveyed

schedule.description: One entry per set. Times are null until officially published — leave unknowns null, never guess.

night.description: Festival night a set is billed under; equals day except for sets after midnight; consumers group lineups by this.

end_day.description: Calendar date of end when it differs from day.

map.description: Stylized vector map. Polygons are deliberately simple (a festival is ~15 shapes), lat/lon pairs, drawn from official maps or on-site GPS traces.

landmarks.description: Named meetup points — the things people actually navigate by.

note.description: Where to find it in words while lat/lon are still null — 'between Wompy Woods and Subsidia', 'known as Becky'. A human hint, not geometry.

events.description: Happenings that are not sets: meet & greets, meetups, workshops, activities, side quests. Optional and additive — a pack without it is complete, and a consumer that never reads it loses nothing. Only things announced by the host or organiser, each with the announcing post in source.url. See docs/events.md.

id.description: Pack-unique and stable across edits — consumers key picks and calendar UIDs on it. Convention: kind prefix, host slug, day suffix (mg-2dy4-sat, mu-bloom-rave-co-fri, sq-great-dino-egg-hunt).

kind.description: Open vocabulary. Known values: meet-greet, meetup, workshop, activity, side-quest, official. A pack may use another string; consumers must show unknown kinds plainly rather than drop them.

title.description: Short, as a person would say it: '2DY4 meet & greet', 'Bloom Rave Co. kandi trade'.

day.description: Calendar date, local. null with start null = runs the whole festival (an egg hunt, a token trail).

start.description: HH:MM local wall time. null = announced for the day, time not yet given — legitimate and common; never guess one.

end.description: HH:MM local, optional. Consumers assume about 30 minutes when absent. May be earlier on the clock than start when it runs past midnight.

night.description: Festival night it is billed under, same rule as schedule: equals day, except after midnight (start before 06:00) it is the previous day. Required whenever start is set; null for all-festival items.

text.description: What a human reads — 'the triceratops right outside The Crater'. Always present, even when stage or landmark is set.

stage.description: Nearest stage id when the host named one, for 'near' grouping. null when they didn't; don't infer.

landmark.description: map.landmarks id when the place is one of them, for devices with a map. null when ambiguous.

host.description: Who is running it, as they present themselves on the announcing account. null when unknown.

name.description: Display name as shown on the account

artist.description: Exact schedule artist string (the pack's spelling) when this is an artist's own meet & greet or activity; links it to their set. null for fan-run things, even ones timed to a set.

series.description: Groups repeats of the same thing on different days ('bloom-rave-co' × 3). One entry per occurrence, sharing this.

description.description: Your own paraphrase, a sentence or two at most: what happens, what to bring. Never the post's text — facts are CC0, the post is not.

status.description: announced = host said when and where; tentative = teased, time or place still open; cancelled = host pulled it — keep the entry so a consumer that cached it can say so.

url.description: The announcing post. Required for announced entries — the citation is what makes this a fact and not a rumour.

seen.description: Date the post was last checked

complete.description: Honest completeness flags so consumers can set expectations
